reviewMethod.wholeSourcePurity: Full-source whole-body plus lower-body review at 10-15 fps before any count was admitted.
reviewMethod.targetedDenseReview: 30 fps lower-body/contact and clip-boundary review was used to resolve ambiguous footwork and first/last completed cycles.
reviewMethod.locatorPolicy: Programmatic motion/shorts signals were used only to locate candidate frames. They did not decide jump-rope type and did not generate GT counts.
reviewMethod.mixedTypePolicy: Any alternate-foot, boxer-step, high-knee, crossover, mixed subtype, or ambiguous non-synchronized footwork anywhere in the source rejects the clip from STANDARD.

rows.note: Coarse whole-source review could look two-foot, but targeted 30 fps shoe/contact review resolved staggered foot contacts: one foot advances/plants while the other lifts. Rejected conservatively under strict STANDARD purity; no GT count admitted.
Starts closer to synchronized basic, then around 5.6 s visibly changes to alternating/high-knee running-step footwork. Whole-source purity therefore fails.
